name: io.github.books-service/ru-books
title: RU Books MCP
description: MCP-сервер для поиска русскоязычных книг, получения карточек и кандидатов для рекомендаций.

tools.name: books_search
tools.description: Search books in catalog by free-text query and pagination. For browse scenarios use dedicated tools (books_by_genre/author/language/format). Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

query.description: Free-text search query: title, author or topic words.

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: books_by_genre
tools.description: Browse books by genre without free-text query. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

genre.description: Genre name or slug as on knigochit.ru (e.g. `фантастика`).

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: books_by_author
tools.description: Browse books by author without free-text query. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

author.description: Author name or part of it, case-insensitive (e.g. `Толстой`).

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: books_by_language
tools.description: Browse books by language without free-text query. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

language.description: Book language code as stored in the catalog, case-insensitive exact match (e.g. `ru`).

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: books_by_format
tools.description: Browse books by format without free-text query. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

format.description: Book format; `book` and `ebook` are synonyms of `text`.

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: books_without_series
tools.description: Browse books that are not part of a series. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

limit.description: Maximum number of books to return (1-50, default 10).

offset.description: Number of books to skip, for paging (default 0).

tools.name: book_details
tools.description: Get detailed catalog card by book_id. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

book_id.description: Book id (the `book_id` field of any search/browse result, e.g. `b123`).

adult_confirmed.description: Set true ONLY if the user has confirmed they are 18 or older; otherwise description/cover of 18+ books are returned as null.

tools.name: recommendation_candidates
tools.description: Get candidate books for agent-side recommendation. Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).

user_query.description: The user's request in natural language (e.g. `что почитать после Мастера и Маргариты`).

limit.description: Maximum number of candidates to return (1-30, default 10).

filters.description: Optional filters that narrow the candidates; all given filters apply together.

author.description: Author name or part of it, case-insensitive (e.g. `Толстой`).

genre.description: Genre name or slug as on knigochit.ru (e.g. `фантастика`).

language.description: Book language code as stored in the catalog, case-insensitive exact match (e.g. `ru`).

min_price.description: Minimum price in rubles among currently available offers.

max_price.description: Maximum price in rubles among currently available offers.

without_series.description: true: only books that are not part of a series.

formats.description: Book formats to include; `book` and `ebook` are synonyms of `text`.
